specialist.description: Everyone: start requests and work the tasks their skills qualify them for.

supervisor.description: Team lead: rebalance work, cancel cases, correct plan records, review the audit log.

auditor.description: Read-only: see everything, including the full audit log, and change nothing. Never routed work.
